why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 82 letters 'AVENUE R 1/2' at its west margin with a printed 70' bracket, its east face carrying avenue numbers '3601 3603 ... 3627' and the 36th St run beginning '2401 2403 2405 2407 2409 2411'. Sheet 81's east corridor carries the matching 2300 side: avenue numbers '3602 3604' and 36th St run ending '2317 2319 2321 2323', with '70' ' lettered in the corridor. So the 2300/2400 change lands on this avenue on both plates; Ave R one west is 2200/2300, Ave S one east 2400/2500. Faces: sheet 81 x=3048/3260; sheet 82 x=77 (west line of the 70' bracket) / 286 (block face).
